name: Customer Churn Analytics
description: An end-to-end churn workspace for data quality, segmentation, prediction, explainability, and retention analysis.
summary: A customer analytics workflow spanning ingestion, profiling, model training, and retention investigation. Customer 360 combines available model, cohort, segment, and explanation outputs around individual customer records.
architecture: Next.js dashboards call versioned FastAPI routes. Services ingest customer CSVs, persist rows and run metadata through SQLAlchemy/PostgreSQL, and manage model artifacts. Scikit-learn and XGBoost power training; SHAP explains model drivers. Deterministic demo data supports local evaluation.

capabilities.name: Customer data profiling
capabilities.description: Ingest CSVs and inspect quality, target normalization, and cleaning previews.

capabilities.name: Churn modeling
capabilities.description: Train and compare models, score customers, and inspect customer-level explanations.

capabilities.name: Retention workspace
capabilities.description: Combine segments, cohorts, prioritization, retention recommendations, and monitoring.

stack.usage: Dashboard pages expose analytics, Customer Explorer, and Customer 360 workflows.
Frontend types align customer data and API response structures.
Routes expose ingestion, training, prediction, segmentation, and monitoring services.
Python services implement customer profiling, feature processing, and business rules.
DataFrames support schema inference, customer analytics, and model feature preparation.
Candidate churn models and clustering workflows fit customer features and evaluate results.
XGBoost provides a candidate estimator in the churn training workflow.
Global and per-customer SHAP outputs expose model feature contributions.
SQLAlchemy models persist dataset rows and analytics-run metadata.
PostgreSQL stores uploaded records and the application workflow state.
Compose runs PostgreSQL, the FastAPI backend, and the frontend together.
Backend tests cover analytics services and explicit business logic.

architectureConnections.description: Dashboard requests invoke the analytics and model APIs.
Fitted model behavior is inspected through feature explanations.
Dataset and run records live in relational storage.
